We aim to investigate the M4 flare and CME event on 28 March 2022 in AR 12975 to determine how well observed coronal dimmings trace the footpoints of an erupting MFR. We also assess how these signatures compare with the MFR evolution from a data-driven magnetofrictional simulation. We combined multiwavelength SDO/AIA observations with a time-dependent data-driven magnetofrictional simulation of the AR. We identified coronal dimmings using intensity-thresholding and minimum-intensity maps. For challenging regions we used a tailored region growth algorithm from strong gradients. We extracted MFR structures in the simulation using a combined twist and squashing factor metric. We compared the location of the footpoints and derived magnetic fluxes from both dimmings and the modelled MFR. The simulation reproduces the formation, evolution, and eruption of the observed MFR whose footpoints migrate during the eruption. The footpoints match well with the dimming location. The southern dimming shows characteristics of a moving flux rope dimming, while the northern dimming behaves as a shrinking flux rope dimming that is rapidly closed by the flare ribbons. Quantitative comparisons of area and magnetic flux show good overall agreement between simulated footpoints and observed dimmings, with discrepancies mainly arising from detection limitations and event complexity. The dimmings at the northern footpoint region is particularly challenging in observations due to pre-existing low intensities and its fast shrinkage.

entries.title: White Dwarf Pulsars: an emerging class of compact binaries
entries.abstract: I summarise the expanding class of white dwarf pulsars for which the prototype, AR Scorpii, was only discovered in 2016. At the time of this meeting, two further systems had been found (eRASSU J191213.9-441044 and SDSS J230641.47+244055.8). These are thought to be detached (or nearly detached) white-dwarf--red-dwarf binaries, where the white dwarf's magnetic field interacts with the M-star's corona, resulting in the capture and acceleration of electrons to relativistic velocities in the magnetosphere. This gives rise to non-thermal synchrotron emission across the electromagnetic spectrum. The first discovered, and brightest, system, AR Sco (which is the focus of this paper), shows a white dwarf spin-down consistent with magnetic dipole emission in a strongly magnetic white dwarf. The polarisation properties of the two systems for which polarimetry has been obtained (AR Sco and eRASSU J191213.9-441044) show spin-modulated polarisation, primarily linear, which remarkably reaches 40% in AR Sco. Furthermore, the Stokes Q and U parameters vary in the same manner as the optical polarisation of the Crab pulsar, consistent with a rotating magnetic dipole. These systems are intriguing in that each one seems to show different behaviours (e.g. pulse profiles and light-curve properties), presumably mainly due to different viewing aspect angles. It has recently been postulated that these systems represent a short-lived phase of binary evolution linking asynchronously rotating intermediate polars and synchronous polars.

entries.title: Relativistic accretion-disc models of Cyg X-1 in the soft state: a case study
entries.abstract: The thermal continuum of Cygnus X-1 in the soft state is often modelled with a multicolour disc in a Newtonian spacetime approximation. That choice is convenient for estimating the inner radius, but it neglects relativistic effects near the black hole; these are usually restored through colour-correction and boundary-condition factors. Using Suzaku data from one exemplary observation, we compare this Newtonian description with some fully relativistic disc models, keeping the same treatment of absorption, ionised winds, Comptonization and reflection. With the mass, distance and inclination fixed to the best current dynamical values, the Newtonian inner radius is consistent with a high-spin Kerr innermost stable circular orbit. The relativistic models do not provide a uniformly better description of the spectrum: some worsen the fit or leave spin, inclination and hardening unconstrained, while the formally best model requires an inclination much larger than the dynamical one or a smaller spin. Apparent tensions with the models arise from data degeneracies and from the limited energy band, not from a failure of general relativity.

entries.title: Broad-band spectral-timing: simultaneous NICER and HXMT observations reveal an anticorrelation between the softest and hardest X-ray fluxes in MAXI J1820+070
entries.abstract: Black hole X-ray binaries (BHXRBs) in the hard state show variable X-ray emission across a wide range of energies. Hard X-rays are thought to be produced through Compton-upscattering of seed photons from the accretion disc by the hot X-ray corona, leading to a spectral component roughly shaped like a power-law with a high-energy cut-off. A complete study of the coronal variability requires a full view of the spectrum, from the low-energy cut-off at the seed photon energy to the high energy cut-off, which may be related to the coronal temperature. We present a detailed spectral-timing study of strictly simultaneous observations by NICER and Insight-HXMT of the bright BHXRB MAXI~J1820+070, covering the 0.3-250 keV energy range. The high data quality allows us to study the lags and coherence across the full X-ray band. We find that at low Fourier frequencies ($\lesssim0.02$ Hz), the soft X-ray flux below 1 keV and hard X-ray flux above 100 keV are anticorrelated, i.e. phase lags of $|π|$ rad. No anticorrelation is observed when comparing energy bands above 1 keV. We consider several explanations for the observed complex behaviour, such as a modulation of the coronal cut-off energy by the disc, power-law pivoting and a contribution from non-thermal electrons. Future, more detailed modelling efforts based on the observed effects may place new constraints on the dynamics of the X-ray emitting regions around accreting black holes.

entries.title: Multi-Band Optical Variability Characteristics of the $γ$-ray emitting blazar 1ES 0647+250 during its 2020 flare
entries.abstract: We present a multi-band optical variability study of the $γ$-ray emitting high-synchrotron-peaked blazar 1ES~0647+250 during its enhanced optical activity in 2020. The analysis utilizes 107 epochs of high-precision $B$, $V$, and $R$-band photometry obtained with the 75 cm telescope at the Vainu Bappu Observatory, combined with high-cadence $z_g$ and $z_r$ survey data from the Zwicky Transient Facility. The combined light curves reveal coherent variability across all optical filters, with the source reaching a peak $R$-band magnitude of 15.74 mag. We calculated the variability amplitude, finding the highest intrinsic variability in the B- band. Spectral analysis using color--magnitude diagrams reveals a statistically significant ``Bluer-When-Brighter'' trend, supported by a Pearson correlation coefficient of $r = 0.68$ ($p < 0.001$) for the (V$-$R) index. Furthermore, the discrete correlation function analysis indicates a near-zero time lag between the $V$ and $R$ bands, suggesting simultaneous emission within the observational cadence. The observed spectral hardening is consistent with synchrotron-dominated optical emission, likely associated with enhanced particle acceleration within the jet during the active phase of 1ES~0647+250.

entries.title: A magnetar-powered jet-wind outflow in gamma-ray burst-associated supernovae: Application to the thermal components of GRB 060218-SN 2006aj
entries.abstract: A rapidly rotating magnetar formed in the collapse of a massive star may release its spin-down power through both a collimated polar jet and a quasi-isotropic magnetar wind. With its long-lasting soft X-ray blackbody component and the double-peaked UV/optical light curves of SN 2006aj, GRB 060218-SN 2006aj provides a useful test case for such a two-component energy-injection scenario. We developed a magnetar-powered jet-wind model in which the two outflows interact with homologously expanding SN ejecta, driving forward shocks that produce shock-breakout emission and subsequent magnetar-powered thermal emission. We first used the jet component to fit the 0.3-10 keV blackbody flux and temperature evolution of GRB 060218 and subsequently added the wind component to model the UV/optical light curves of SN 2006aj. We find that the soft X-ray blackbody component can be reproduced mainly by shock-breakout emission from the polar ejecta driven by the jet. The double-peaked UV/optical light curves are instead produced by the interaction between the quasi-isotropic magnetar wind and a more massive ejecta component. The first optical peak is dominated by wind-driven shock-breakout emission, whereas the broader and later emission is powered mainly by the subsequent magnetar-powered thermal component. Our results suggest a two-component magnetar-engine picture for GRB 060218-SN 2006aj, in which the X-ray thermal emission and the UV/optical double-peaked evolution arise from different energy-injection channels of the same central engine.

entries.title: Energy estimation of direct and reflected cosmic-ray events aboard balloon-borne radio detectors
entries.abstract: Balloon-borne radio detectors offer a highly effective approach to monitoring immense volumes of the Earth's atmosphere and ice for ultra-high-energy cosmic rays and neutrinos. Because these payloads measure radio emission from a single, highly elevated vantage point, reconstructing the air-shower energy using traditional methods is not possible. In this work, we present a comprehensive, simulation-based energy reconstruction framework tailored to the unique cosmic-ray event geometries observed by balloon payloads. For the first time, we adapt and apply this methodology to direct atmosphere-skimming cosmic-ray showers, accounting for their highly asymmetric development in rarefied air. Furthermore, we provide a major update to the energy reconstruction of reflected downward-going showers by incorporating spherical reflection and ray de-focusing mechanics directly into simulations. We rigorously validate the method across different event geometries, demonstrating a baseline energy resolution of $8-11\%$. Finally, we quantify the systematic effects of finite detector pointing resolution, unknown primary mass composition, and signal-to-noise ratio, establishing a robust framework for the analysis of cosmic-ray events in next-generation balloon missions such as PUEO and POEMMA-Balloon with Radio.

entries.title: Anisotropy and energy distribution of leptons and photons in radiative relativistic Alfvénic turbulence
entries.abstract: The anisotropic evolution of relativistic particles in magnetically dominated Alfvénic turbulence is a fundamental process governing nonthermal emissions in high-energy astrophysical environments. In this work, we develop a theoretical framework by deriving scaling equations that characterize the pitch-angle dynamics of leptons and photons across both weak- and strong-radiative cooling regimes. Our model reveals a universal coupling between particle energy and angular distribution, arising from the interplay of field-aligned accelerations, perpendicular drift motions, and radiation reactions. The model can uniquely identify ``turning-point energies" that exhibit a nonlinear dependence on the local magnetic field and the energy-injection scale. The validity of this scaling model is confirmed through radiative particle-in-cell simulations. We show that the electron pitch-angle distribution fundamentally dictates photon emission characteristics, further revealing a pronounced statistical correlation between high-energy photon emission and turbulent vortices in the reconnection regions. By bridging the gap between small-scale kinetic interactions and broad-band spectral characteristics, this work provides a quantitative basis for interpreting the hardening of radiation spectra and complex polarization signatures in sources such as pulsar wind nebulae and gamma-ray bursts.

entries.title: ALMA's sharpest view of IRAS 08544-4431: Unveiling the dust distribution asymmetries in the circumbinary disk
entries.abstract: The interactions between post-asymptotic giant branch (post-AGB) binaries and their circumbinary disks play a central role in shaping the evolution of these systems. Circumbinary disks around post-AGB binaries are stable, though relatively short-lived structures ($10^4-10^5$ years) and their physical properties and evolution remain poorly understood. In this study, we target IRAS 08544-4431, one of the best-studied post-AGB binaries. This system has well-constrained stellar and orbital parameters, exhibits well-defined characteristic refractory-depleted photospheric chemistry, and hosts a stable, sub-Keplerian circumbinary disk extending from a well-resolved sublimation rim at approximately 8 au to outer radii of approximately 1 000 au. We probe the disk layers close to the midplane using ALMA Band 7 continuum and $^{12}$CO $J=3-2$ observations of IRAS 08544-4431 obtained with baselines up to 16.2 km. These data provide the finest angular resolution yet achieved with ALMA for dust-continuum observations of post-AGB binaries with a (almost) face-on disk (15 au; 10 mas). The resulting map of dust continuum enabled resolving disk inner rim, a largely smooth radial profile, and a prominent azimuthal asymmetry at a radius of $\sim$45 mas. Notably, the location of this dust asymmetry coincides with the forward-scattering peak reported in SPHERE/VLT observations of IRAS 08544-4431. The $^{12}$CO emission is more extended than the dust continuum and confirms the disk rotation in this system. However, the global $^{12}$CO map shows indications of a spatial offset from the dust asymmetry, suggesting some degree of gas-dust decoupling. Together, these observations establish IRAS 08544-4431 as a key laboratory for studying disk and dust evolution in a parameter space distinct from that of young stars with protoplanetary disks.

entries.title: Stellar flares with Ariel: detection prospects and impacts on exoplanet spectroscopy
entries.abstract: Stellar flares are important tracers of magnetic activity and can significantly influence the characterization of exoplanet host stars by introducing time-dependent astrophysical variability. ESA's Ariel mission, designed for atmospheric characterization of exoplanets, will include the VISPhot instrument, providing high-cadence optical photometry offering an opportunity to study stellar flares while identifying and mitigating their impact on transit spectroscopy. We discuss Ariel's potential for flare studies, emphasizing the importance of short-cadence observations for resolving flare morphology and estimating flare energies. We identify potential flaring targets within the Ariel Mission Candidate Sample by cross-matching it with a TESS-based flare catalog, identifying 44 stars in the sample of 3321 host stars with flare rates spanning 0.0012-1.05 flares per day yielding a lower limit. The majority of these active stars are expected to flare infrequently during typical Ariel observations, but for a few of the most active targets there is a significant chance of flaring during a typical Ariel observing window. We further investigate the detectability of stellar flares in Ariel's wavelength range using synthetic spectra based on time-dependent RADYN flare models propagated through the Ariel radiometric simulator. Our simulations indicate that strong flares on cool dwarfs can produce measurable infrared signatures, with flux variations reaching several percent, substantially exceeding the amplitudes of typical exoplanet atmospheric features. These results demonstrate stellar flares represent both a valuable ancillary science case and a potential source of contamination for Ariel observations, highlighting the need for improved flare models and mitigation strategies to maximize the mission's scientific return.

analysis.reading_entry: Abstract
analysis.problem: 利用Euclid数据研究截至z=1的大规模星系样本中，盘面亮度剖面折断的结构性质及红移演化。
analysis.method: 对Euclid Q1中选出的8748个盘星系建立自动处理流程，进行掩膜、表面亮度剖面提取、积分测光、结构参数测量及分段建模，将剖面分类为I、II、III型和复合折断类型，并分析结构参数分布及其红移依赖。
limits: 自动剖面分类的估计准确率为70%。
主要统计结果使用4385个分类可靠的星系子样本，而非全部8748个输入星系。
citation_leads: Abstract: “Changes in the slope of the radial surface brightness profiles of disc galaxies, or disc breaks, encode valuable information about the processes driving disc formation and growth.”

Abstract: “We aim to study the structural properties and redshift evolution of disc breaks in a large and statistically representative sample of galaxies out to redshift z=1 using the superb depth and resolution of Euclid.”
Abstract: “We develop an automatic pipeline to extract and analyse surface brightness profiles of 8748 disc galaxies selected from the Euclid Q1 dataset.”

Abstract: “The pipeline includes advanced masking, surface brightness profile extraction, integrated photometry and structural parameter measurements, and piecewise modelling to classify galaxies into Types I (pure exponential), Type II (down-bending), Type III (up-bending), and composite break (e.g., Type~II+III, Type~II+II, etc) profiles.”
Abstract: “We quantify structural parameters such as scale lengths, break radii, and surface brightness levels, and analyse their distributions and redshift dependence.”
Abstract: “Our automatic method produces reliable masks and deep surface brightness profiles, and classifies galaxy profiles with an estimated accuracy of 70%.”
Abstract: “Using a subsample of 4385 galaxies with reliable classifications, we find that the most common profiles are Types II, II+III, I, and III.”
Abstract: “Type II profiles dominate at low redshift (50%), while Types III and II+III profiles increase in frequency with lookback time, reaching 30% each at z~1.”
Abstract: “Until now, due to the resolution and depth required, statistical studies of break types have been limited mostly to the local Universe.”
Abstract: “Our study provides the first statistically robust measurement of the evolution of disc break types over 5 Gyr.”
Abstract: “The observed trends support a scenario in which secular processes replace environmental influences as galaxies mature.”

analysis.result: NGC 3344 的径向金属丰度梯度为 -0.378 dex R25^-1；扩展紫外盘 H II 区的金属丰度散布接近内盘的两倍，并存在异常低金属丰度区域。H I 运动学模型显示，扩展紫外盘内气体以平均 6 km s^-1 的径向速度向内运动，可能为恒星形成供给气体并稀释金属丰度。化学演化模型表明，扩展紫外盘起始位置的气体比例、有效产额及质量加载因子剖面出现扰动。
analysis.reading_entry: 摘要
analysis.problem: 异常低金属丰度 H II 区是否与贫金属气体吸积及径向气体流入直接相关，以及这种气体流动如何影响扩展紫外盘的恒星形成和星系增长。
analysis.method: 使用 VLA 高分辨率 H I 21 cm 成像测量中性气体运动学，使用 MMT 多狭缝光学光谱测量 76 个 H II 区的气相金属丰度；利用 3DBarolo 倾斜环模型拟合 H I 盘，并通过化学演化模型分析气体比例、有效产额和质量加载因子剖面。
assumptions: 异常低金属丰度 H II 区被假设为贫金属气体吸积的结果。
citation_leads: Abstract: “We present evidence connecting anomalously low-metallicity regions to radial gas inflows in the extended ultraviolet (XUV) disk of the galaxy NGC 3344.”

Abstract: “Anomalously low-metallicity H II regions are hypothesized to result from the accretion of metal-poor gas, but a direct link between gas flows and low metallicity gas has not been previously established.”

Abstract: “We use high-resolution H I-21cm imaging from the Very Large Array to trace neutral gas kinematics and multi-slit optical spectroscopy from the MMT to trace the gas-phase metallicity of 76 H II regions in NGC 3344.”

Abstract: “The galaxy exhibits a negative radial metallicity gradient of $-0.378$ dex $\mathrm{R}_{25}^{-1}$, with H II regions in the XUV disk showing nearly twice the metallicity scatter of those in the inner disk and several showing an anomalously low metallicity.”

Abstract: “Modeling the H I disk as tilted rings with 3DBarolo, we find gas moving radially inwards within the XUV disk at an average radial velocity of 6 $\mathrm{km\ s^{-1}}$, likely fueling star formation and diluting the metallicity, thereby producing anomalously low metallicity regions.”
Abstract: “Chemical evolution models indicate that the gas fraction, effective yield, and mass-loading factor profiles are disrupted at the onset of the XUV disk, as expected from recent gas flows.”
Abstract: “This example is the first direct detection of how radial gas flows can support stellar disk expansion and cause inside-out galaxy growth.”

analysis.result: 模拟预测μTDE吸积可增加低质量致密天体的自旋，并使部分中子星坍缩形成低质量黑洞；总体有效自旋分布的变化较弱，当前模拟没有建立平均有效自旋随既往μTDE次数单调变化的趋势。默认模型的μTDE主要来自单致密天体与恒星遭遇，事件率应视为仅动力学组装通道的下限。μTDE随机引力波背景比LISA和LGWA灵敏度低数个数量级，预测不可探测。电磁可见比例、μTDE与并合事件数之比以及经历过μTDE的并合天体比例在不同段落中存在不一致，无法确认统一的精确值。

analysis.reason: 与研究组的超新星中微子、恒星包层环境及 MeV 高能瞬变观测直接相关。论文把包层产生的 511 keV 回声与地面中微子计数结合，提出检验传播效应的近—远比较方法，并量化光子输运校准要求；即使目前尚不能稳健解释通量亏损，这些方法与限制也具有明确研究效用。
analysis.result: 构造与距离无关的近—远估计量 κ：标准传播预期 κ=1，完全平均的伪狄拉克振荡预期 κ≈1/2。正文给出的振荡特征质量平方劈裂尺度为 δm²≈10⁻¹⁸ eV²×(0.22 kpc/D)×(E★/15 MeV)，不是已实现的观测限制。在 D=0.222 kpc、AMEGO 类有效面积 3000 cm²、20 M☉ 前身星的基准下，预测回声计数为 70.7；若有效面积不确定度为 5%，分辨因子二亏损要求回声归一化 Cγ 的相对不确定度在 2σ、3σ 下分别不超过 48.3%、30.7%。当前光子逃逸处方存在四倍差异，仍可吸收这一亏损。

analysis.problem: 银河系超新星中微子的能量平滑传播抑制，尤其完全平均的活跃—惰性振荡，如何与不确定的源发射归一化区分？能否通过包层产生的伽马射线回声独立锚定恒星表面电子反中微子注量？
analysis.method: 采用富氢包层表面逃逸层近似，计算逆 β 衰变产生正电子并湮灭形成的 511 keV 回声；将回声计数与地面 IBD 计数写成具有相同 IBD 截面加权的表面发射积分，构造 κ=(NIBD/Nγ)×(Aeff Cγ/(Np εIBD))。以共同质量平方劈裂的伪狄拉克模型为例，结合 Garching SFHo 发射模型、SNOwGLoBES 截面及 JUNO 高斯能量响应计算基准谱，并传播计数、背景和不相关系统误差，给出回声统计量与归一化校准精度的要求。
assumptions: 电子反中微子发射球对称，朝向地球一侧包层的注量与恒星表面其他区域相同。
回声采用可无康普顿散射逃逸的表面层近似；该层的自由质子与电子数目分数之比近似均匀，向内光子被吸收，向外的一半光子视为逃逸。
伪狄拉克基准对三对活跃—惰性态采用共同的质量平方劈裂，并在标准振荡相位平均后计算额外传播因子。
基准表面注量采用完全味均分；地面 IBD 效率近似不依赖能量，误差预算采用不相关系统误差。
回声灵敏度基准采用 D=0.222 kpc、AMEGO 类有效面积 3000 cm²、有效面积相对不确定度 5%，并以银河系 511 keV 线背景计算背景计数。
limits: 当前光子逃逸处方存在四倍归一化差异，足以吸收因子二伪狄拉克亏损；稳健解释需要专门的包层光子输运与目标校准计算。
下一代 MeV 望远镜的回声可探测范围仅约为 1 kpc 以内，方法适用的超新星距离有限。
背景估计只包括银河系 511 keV 线，未纳入依赖仪器和能窗的连续谱及仪器背景。
参宿四距离的超新星可能导致 JUNO 高事件率与堆积；采用的效率只是基准，仍需专门的探测器模拟与重建。

analysis.result: 在 24 个星系团样本中，几乎所有系统中心约 10 kpc 内的低熵气体都足以解释观测到的分子气体质量；分子气体质量与空腔排开的最大气体质量近似线性相关。在假设排开气体的 50% 被抬升并冷却时，当前空腔寿命内预期冷却的质量在若干系统中与分子气体库相当，但其他系统存在更多分子气体。结果支持重复 AGN 爆发通过气体抬升促进低熵气体凝结、积累分子气体库的图景。

analysis.problem: 冷核星系团中，空腔驱动的气体抬升能否促进分子气体形成，并解释观测到的分子气体库。
analysis.method: 利用 24 个星系团样本，量化气体抬升的质量、速度、半径及冷却时间参数空间，并将被排开的热气体与观测到的分子气体质量比较。
assumptions: 估算当前观测空腔寿命内的冷却质量时，假设被排开的气体质量中有 50% 被抬升并冷却。
limits: 在所述 50% 假设下，当前空腔寿命内的预期冷却质量只能在若干系统中与分子气体库相当；其他系统存在过量分子气体，因此摘要保留了多轮反馈循环或其他过程的可能性。
citation_leads: Abstract: “We present a study of gas uplift by cavities and its role in promoting the formation of molecular gas in cool-core galaxy clusters.”

Abstract: “Using a sample of 24 clusters, we quantify the parameter space of gas uplift, including lifting masses, velocities, radii, and cooling times, and compare the displaced hot gas to observed molecular gas masses.”
Abstract: “Almost all clusters contain sufficient low-entropy gas within the central $\sim$10 kpc to account for the observed molecular gas.”
Abstract: “The molecular gas mass scales approximately linearly with the maximum gas mass displaced by cavities.”

Abstract: “The mass expected to cool over the lifetimes of the currently observed cavities is comparable to the molecular reservoir in several systems, assuming that 50\% of the displaced gas mass is lifted and cools, whereas other systems contain excess molecular gas.”
Abstract: “This suggests that the molecular gas reservoirs may have accumulated over multiple AGN feedback cycles involving repeated gas uplift and cooling, or through additional processes.”
Abstract: “Overall, our results support a picture in which repeated AGN outbursts with gas uplift promote the condensation of low-entropy gas and help build molecular reservoirs in cool-core BCGs.”

analysis.reading_entry: Abstract
analysis.problem: z>6 星系中的极致密恒星团块能否通过早期星系盘碎裂原位形成，以及恒星反馈如何调节其性质与后续演化。
analysis.method: 对孤立星系 Ninfea_blu 开展一组辐射流体动力学模拟；暗晕维里质量为 1.5×10^10 太阳质量，从 z=16 演化至 z=12.5，持续 100 Myr，最高空间分辨率为 3.6 pc。
assumptions: 模拟采用孤立星系设置。
limits: 所述模拟演化时长为 100 Myr，红移范围为 z=16 至 12.5，最高空间分辨率为 3.6 pc。
citation_leads: Abstract: “We investigate whether such systems can form in-situ through the fragmentation of an early galactic disk and how stellar feedback regulates their properties.”

Abstract: “We perform a suite of radiation-hydrodynamical simulations of an isolated galaxy ("Ninfea_blu"), with $\rm M_{vir}=1.5\times10^{10} M_\odot$, evolved for 100 Myr from z=16 to 12.5 with a maximum spatial resolution of 3.6 pc.”
Abstract: “In all cases, the gas rapidly forms a rotationally supported disk, reaches a peak star formation rate of $10-15\rm M_\odot yr^{-1}$, and fragments into dense stellar clumps.”

Abstract: “Toomre-unstable regions ($Q_{\rm gas}<1$) appear before the onset of star formation, and the first stellar structures form preferentially within these regions, supporting a Toomre-like gravitational fragmentation pathway.”

Abstract: “Feedback reduces the cumulative stellar mass by 30-40%, lowers the gas mass retained within clumps by ~1 dex, and suppresses their high-mass tail without preventing their initial formation.”
Abstract: “Clumps subsequently migrate, interact, undergo tidal stripping, and disperse. The clump mass function produces a power law slope of -1.88, which aligns closely with observations.”

Abstract: “We conclude that fragmentation of compact, gas-rich disks provides a viable origin for many of the dense stellar systems observed in the early Universe, while feedback and internal dynamics primarily regulate their growth and fate.”
analysis.research_progress: 通过模拟提供了致密富气体星系盘碎裂能够形成早期宇宙恒星团块的证据，并区分了初始形成与后续调节：反馈不阻止团块初始形成，但反馈与内部动力学主要调节其增长和最终命运。

analysis.result: 两套模型均可在星暴后数 Myr 内产生最高约 log(N/O)≈0.1 的增强。含光学厚风的模型在约 3–4 Myr 时因富 C/O 的风迅速转向 log(N/O)≈−1.5 的正常状态；不含光学厚风时转变更慢、更弱。光学厚风模型能解释三个具有直接 WR 光谱特征的高红移星系的 C、N、O、He 丰度模式，而仅含光学薄风的模型不能解释 Sunburst Arc 和 MARTA 4327。
analysis.reading_entry: 摘要
analysis.problem: 旋转大质量恒星的光学厚风能否解释高红移星系中增强的 N/O，以及不同风模型如何影响元素产额和丰度随星暴年龄的演化。
analysis.method: 使用两套分别包含和不包含光学厚风的 MESA 单星演化模型，计算约 20–100 太阳质量贫金属恒星的金属产额；覆盖金属丰度和初始自转的密集网格，采用基于 SMC O 型星观测的初始自转分布，并与具有 WR 特征的高红移星系丰度模式比较。
assumptions: 计算采用单星演化模型。
采用基于 SMC O 型星观测的初始自转分布。
citation_leads: Abstract: “Strong optically-thick winds of rotating massive stars going through the Wolf-Rayet (WR) phase provide a viable explanation for such N/O enhancements”

Abstract: “Here, we compute the metal yields of massive ($\sim 20-100\ \rm M_\odot$), metal-poor stars using two sets of \textsc{mesa} single stellar evolution models with and without optically-thick winds in a dense grid of metallicities ($Z_\star\sim 0.001-0.0045$) and initial spins ($ω\equivΩ/Ω_{\rm crit}\sim 0-0.7$).”

Abstract: “Considering an initial spin distribution based on observations of O-type stars in the SMC, we find that both sets produce strong N/O enhancements up to $\rm \log(N/O)\sim 0.1$ within a few Myr after a starburst.”

Abstract: “The models with optically-thick winds undergo a rapid transition from high N/O to the `normal' state of $\rm \log(N/O)\sim -1.5$ at $t\sim 3-4$~Myr driven by C/O-rich winds, while the transition is slower and weaker without optically-thick winds.”

Abstract: “The optically-thick-wind scenario can reproduce the nebular C, N, O, and He abundance patterns of three representative high-$z$ galaxies showing direct WR signatures: RXCJ2248-ID, Sunburst Arc, and MARTA 4327”
Abstract: “In contrast, the optically-thin-wind-only scenario ejects much less C and O via winds and cannot reproduce Sunburst Arc and MARTA 4327.”
Abstract: “The yields are available at https://zenodo.org/records/22897057.”

analysis.reason: 研究重点是高红移 Little Red Dots 的模拟识别、AGN 与宿主的亮度选择效应及其持续时间。虽然涉及气体包裹的 AGN 环境与未分辨的 AGN 变光，但摘要未建立与 FRB/PRS、超新星中心引擎、激波破越、周星介质相互作用、平台期、光电离与色散测量、相对论喷流、中微子或致密天体高能观测的实质联系。
analysis.result: 气体包裹的 AGN 模型对再现暗弱 LRD（F444W 星等 > 26.0）至关重要。AMBRA 在 z≳6 时相对低估 LRD 数量；加入未分辨的 AGN 变光后，数量随红移的下降变缓，更接近观测。模拟中的 LRD 是既存黑洞—星系系统经历的阶段，主要由 AGN 相对宿主的亮度选出。绝大多数模拟 LRD 的持续时间在约 3–300 Myr 之间，并随黑洞及宿主质量增加；较低质量 LRD 更依赖气体包裹的 AGN，持续时间约 30 Myr；较高质量 LRD 对 AGN 环境较不敏感，但需要更紧致的宿主，持续时间约 100 Myr。
analysis.reading_entry: Abstract
analysis.problem: AMBRA 模拟能否再现 z=5–8 的 LRD，以及 AGN 环境、变光和宿主性质如何影响其识别、数量演化与持续时间。
analysis.method: 在 AMBRA 宇宙学流体动力学模拟中，为 z=5–8 的星系和 AGN 生成模拟观测，比较标准 AGN 发射模型与气体包裹模型，加入未分辨的 AGN 变光，并利用已有时间序列约束 LRD 持续时间。
limits: AGN 环境未被分辨，因此无法确定 LRD 阶段的精确持续时间，只能利用已有时间序列给出限制。
citation_leads: Abstract: “We identify and analyze the little red dots (LRDs) in the AMBRA cosmological hydrodynamic simulation, by producing mock observations of the galaxies and active galactic nuclei (AGN) between redshifts 5 and 8.”

Abstract: “We produce these mock observations with both a standard AGN emission model, and a ``gas-enshrouded'' model, and find that the presence of a gas-enshrouded AGN is instrumental to the reproduction of dim LRDs (F444W magnitude $>$ 26.0).”
Abstract: “We find a steeper decrease in LRD density between $z=5$ and $z=8$ within AMBRA than seen in observations, resulting in a relative underproduction of LRDs beyond $z\sim6$ in AMBRA.”

Abstract: “With the addition of unresolved AGN variability, the decline with redshift flattens, and the LRD redshift evolution in AMBRA becomes broadly consistent with other theoretical datasets, and closer to that seen in observations.”
Abstract: “We find that the LRDs in AMBRA are pre-existing black hole--galaxy systems that are undergoing an LRD phase, selected primarily by the brightness of the AGN relative to its host.”

Abstract: “While the exact duration of these LRD phases is not possible to determine due to the unresolved nature of the AGN environment, we use the available time-series data to place limits on the lifetimes of the LRDs in AMBRA.”
Abstract: “We find that the vast majority of LRDs in AMBRA have lifetimes between $\sim3$ and $\sim 300$ Myr with LRD lifetime increasing with both black hole and host galaxy mass.”

Abstract: “The lower mass LRDs are more dependent on housing a gas-enshrouded AGN, and have shorter lifetimes ($\rm \sim30~Myr$). The higher mass LRDs are less sensitive to their AGN environment, but require more compact host galaxies, and have longer lifetimes ($\rm \sim100~Myr$).”
analysis.research_progress: 在 AMBRA 中比较两种 AGN 发射模型对 LRD 再现的影响，检验未分辨 AGN 变光对红移演化的作用，并给出模拟 LRD 持续时间及其与黑洞、宿主质量关系的约束。

analysis.result: M 矮星多凌星行星系统的宿主星显著比单凌星行星系统贫金属（p = 0.00079）；仅考虑小于 4 个地球半径的行星时，该差异仍显著（p = 0.0013）。这一差异在晚 K 型至 M 型矮星的过渡处出现。M 矮星多行星系统的金属丰度随行星数量增加而降低；单行星系统中的行星具有显著更高的偏心率和更短的轨道周期。
analysis.reading_entry: Abstract
analysis.problem: 只有一颗被探测到的凌星行星与有多颗被探测到的凌星行星的系统，其宿主星金属丰度是否不同，以及这些差异对行星系统动力学起源有何含义。
analysis.method: 使用 FGK 和 M 矮星化学丰度的同质样本，比较单凌星与多凌星行星系统的宿主星金属丰度，并考察小行星子样本、行星数量、偏心率和轨道周期的差异。
citation_leads: Abstract: “It is unclear if host star metallicities differ between systems with one detected transiting planet ("singles") or multiple detected transiting planets ("multis") around FGK dwarfs.”

Abstract: “We use a homogeneous sample of FGK and M dwarf chemical abundances to demonstrate that M dwarf multis are significantly more metal-poor than singles ($p$ = 0.00079), even when we only consider small (<4 $R_{\oplus}$) planets ($p$ = 0.0013).”
Abstract: “This result emerges at the late-K to M dwarf transition. We observe that M dwarf multis become more metal-poor as a function of increasing planet multiplicity.”
Abstract: “Additionally, planets in singles have significantly higher eccentricities and shorter orbital periods compared to planets in multis.”

Abstract: “We interpret these findings as evidence that M dwarf singles lead relatively active dynamical lives, and the different planetary architectures of singles and multis arise from distinct dynamics influenced by metallicity.”

analysis.result: 在所用模拟数据上，模型恢复二维暗物质密度分布的典型精度约为 0.1 dex，随机采样给出的预测不确定度典型值也约为 0.1 dex。域外测试表明模型可定性推广至 TNG50 星系，但对星系形成模型敏感；对 FIRE 测试星系的内区分布（r≲5 kpc）高估约 0.2–0.4 dex。
analysis.reading_entry: Abstract
analysis.problem: 能否利用较易从大规模测光巡天获得的恒星密度分布，推断银河系质量星系的暗物质分布，从而减少对昂贵运动学光谱观测的依赖。
analysis.method: 采用条件生成模型框架，以 DREAMS 流体动力学模拟中的恒星分布与暗物质密度图训练随机桥映射，通过随机采样估计预测不确定度，并使用 IllustrisTNG 和 FIRE 的银河系质量星系进行域外测试。
limits: 概念验证使用不含仪器系统误差的恒星分布作为训练输入。
模型对星系形成模型敏感，在 FIRE 测试星系的内区（r≲5 kpc）出现约 0.2–0.4 dex 的高估。
citation_leads: Abstract: “we explore a conditional generative model framework to map the dark matter profile of Milky Way-mass galaxies from stellar density profiles”
Abstract: “Constraining the dark matter profile of galaxies beyond the Milky Way traditionally requires expensive spectroscopic observations for kinematic information.”

Abstract: “As a proof of concept, we train the model to learn a stochastic bridge between instrument systematics-free baryonic stellar distributions and underlying dark matter density maps from the DREAMS hydrodynamics simulation suite.”
Abstract: “We recover 2D dark matter density profiles with a typical accuracy of $\sim0.1$ dex”
Abstract: “The stochastic sampling procedure provides uncertainty estimates of the predicted dark matter map, with typical values $\sim0.1$ dex.”

Abstract: “Out-of-domain tests with Milky Way-mass galaxies from IllustrisTNG and FIRE simulations show that, while the model can qualitatively be generalized to TNG50 galaxies from IllustrisTNG, the model is sensitive to the galaxy formation model, with $\sim0.2$-$0.4$ dex over-prediction for the inner profiles ($r\lesssim5$ kpc) of the FIRE test galaxies.”

Abstract: “Our results are a first step towards using generative models as a flexible, uncertainty-aware framework for turning forthcoming data from large imaging surveys into spatially resolved dark matter maps.”

analysis.result: 甲酸甲酯在甲醇冰上的结合弱于水冰：非晶水冰、晶态水冰和非晶甲醇冰上的代表性结合能分别约为 6247 K、6213 K 和 5469 K；晶态甲醇冰上的有效结合能为 5333 K。摘要给出的特征脱附温度在甲醇冰上约为 85 K，在水冰上约为 95–100 K，支持甲醇富集冰中的甲酸甲酯先于整体水冰升华释放的两步热脱附路径。
analysis.reading_entry: Abstract
analysis.problem: 冰的组成和相态如何影响甲酸甲酯脱附，以及为何恒星形成环境中会在明显低于水冰升华温度时出现气相甲酸甲酯。
analysis.method: 对非晶和晶态水冰、甲醇冰四种基底上的甲酸甲酯进行实验室程序升温脱附测量；采用由过渡态理论推导的指前因子，结合前沿分析和非负最小二乘反演分析脱附动力学并恢复结合能分布。
citation_leads: Abstract: “Complex organic molecules are widely detected in star-forming regions and are important precursors to prebiotic species.”
Abstract: “observations increasingly reveal gas-phase abundances of methyl formate (MF) at temperatures well below the sublimation temperature of water ice (T ~ 100K), challenging this view.”

Abstract: “To investigate how ice composition and phase influence MF desorption, we present laboratory temperature-programmed desorption measurements of MF from four astrophysically relevant substrates: amorphous and crystalline H$_2$O and CH$_3$OH.”

Abstract: “Desorption kinetics were analyzed using pre-exponential factors derived from transition-state theory with leading-edge analysis and non-negative least-squares inversion to recover binding-energy distributions.”

Abstract: “We find that MF binds more weakly to CH$_3$OH ice than to H$_2$O-rich substrates, with representative binding energies of ~6247K for amorphous H$_2$O, ~6213K for crystalline H$_2$O, and ~5469K for amorphous CH$_3$OH.”
Abstract: “MF deposited on crystalline CH$_3$OH exhibits coverage-independent leading edges consistent with multilayer or island desorption, yielding an effective binding energy of 5333K.”

Abstract: “Enhanced surface mobility and reduced trapping efficiency on methanol ice, combined with weaker MF binding, provide a natural explanation for the early appearance of gas-phase MF observed in star-forming environments, with characteristic desorption temperatures of ~85K on CH$_3$OH and ~95-100K on H$_2$O.”
Abstract: “Together, these effects support a two-step thermal desorption pathway in which MF associated with CH$_3$OH-rich ice can be released prior to bulk H$_2$O sublimation.”
analysis.research_progress: 实验表明甲醇冰上的较弱结合、增强的表面迁移率及降低的俘获效率，可为恒星形成环境中气相甲酸甲酯的提前出现提供解释，并支持两步热脱附路径。

analysis.reason: 该工作主要构建银河系 Vela-Carina 区域的中红外超额源目录，用于识别候选年轻恒星体并表征其光谱能量分布、距离和变光。摘要未建立其与 FRB/PRS 环境、超新星中心引擎、激波破越、周星介质相互作用或其他目标高能瞬变方向的实质联系；其中的周星物质与变光诊断不足以构成相关性。
analysis.result: 从包含 249,719 个源的匹配目录中识别出 1,512 个中红外超额对象，其中 191 个具有完整的 12 波段、S/N > 10 的测光数据，可进行详细 SED 分析。SED 分析独立支持大多数源的中红外超额性质。约 15% 的源被 Gaia 标记为变源，NEOWISE 显示数个十分之一星等的中红外变化。
analysis.reading_entry: Abstract
analysis.problem: 在高消光和源拥挤条件下，识别 Vela-Carina 区域的红外超额候选源，并表征其超出恒星光球的辐射。
analysis.method: 采用分层位置交叉匹配，结合 DECaPS 光学、VVVX 近红外及 Spitzer/GLIMPSE 中红外测光；利用测光质量和中红外颜色诊断筛选候选源，通过 VOSA 和理论大气模型网格分析 SED，采用光度几何距离，并结合 Gaia DR3 与 NEOWISE 变光诊断。
limits: 高消光和源拥挤妨碍探测。
1,512 个中红外超额对象中，仅 191 个具有完整的 12 波段、S/N > 10 测光，可进行详细 SED 分析。
citation_leads: Abstract: “Multiwavelength surveys of the Galactic midplane enable the identification of infrared-excess sources, signatures of circumstellar material, though high extinction and crowding hinder detection.”
Abstract: “We combine optical photometry from DECaPS, near-infrared photometry from VVVX, and mid-infrared photometry from Spitzer/GLIMPSE using hierarchical positional cross-matching.”
Abstract: “Candidates are selected via photometric quality and MIR color diagnostics, and their SEDs are analyzed with VOSA using theoretical atmosphere model grids.”
Abstract: “Photogeometric distances are adopted, while Gaia DR3 and NEOWISE variability provide complementary diagnostics.”

Abstract: “From the matched 249,719-source VVVX-GLIMPSE-DECaPS catalog, we identify 1,512 MIR-excess objects, of which 191 have complete 12-band photometry with S/N > 10, enabling detailed SED analysis.”
Abstract: “SED analysis independently supports the MIR-excess nature of most sources, indicating emission beyond stellar photospheres.”
Abstract: “About 15% of sources are flagged variable by Gaia, while NEOWISE light curves reveal MIR variability of a few tenths of a magnitude.”

Abstract: “Comparisons with published YSO and variability-selected catalogs show limited overlap, particularly with variability-selected samples, indicating that MIR-excess selection complements other approaches to identifying candidate YSOs in the Vela-Carina region.”

Abstract: “The resulting catalog provides a well-defined MIR-excess sample with homogeneous multiband photometry, SED characterization, distances, and variability diagnostics, forming a foundation for future spectroscopic and time-domain studies.”
analysis.research_progress: 提供具有同质多波段测光、SED 表征、距离和变光诊断的中红外超额样本；与已发表 YSO 和变光筛选目录的重叠有限，表明中红外超额筛选可补充其他候选 YSO 识别方法。

analysis.reason: 研究重点是 Seyfert 星系 Mrk 573 的金属富集与吸积盘内原位恒星形成。摘要虽提到喷流周围的双锥区域，但没有实质研究相对论喷流动力学、高能瞬变或所列其他研究方向，因此在摘要筛选阶段跳过。
analysis.result: 在厚盘（H/r ~ 0.1）情形下，服从 Salpeter 初始质量函数的恒星群可以解释观测到的金属富集；作者认为薄盘（H/r ≲ 0.01）与该富集不相容。模型中的 AGN 金属丰度对盘厚度的依赖最强。
analysis.reading_entry: 摘要
analysis.problem: Mrk 573 星系核及喷流周围双锥区域的显著金属富集，能否由吸积盘内原位形成的恒星群解释。
analysis.method: 构建简单金属富集模型，假设吸积盘内原位形成质量为 10–30 个太阳质量的恒星，采用 Salpeter 初始质量函数及同质量场星的典型金属产额，比较厚盘与薄盘情形。
assumptions: 质量为 10–30 个太阳质量的恒星群在吸积盘内原位形成。
恒星形成遵循 Salpeter 初始质量函数。
这些恒星产生与同质量场星相同的典型金属产额。
limits: 作者认为 H/r ≲ 0.01 的薄盘与观测到的金属富集不相容。
citation_leads: Abstract: “Recent observations of the nearby Seyfert galaxy Mrk 573 found that the galactic nucleus and bicone regions surrounding the jet are significantly metal-enriched.”
Abstract: “we develop a simple model for the observed metal enrichment, assuming a population of stars in the $10 - 30 \, M_{\odot}$ range formed in-situ in the accretion disk.”
Abstract: “We assume the stars form according to a Salpeter initial mass function and generate the typical metal yields expected of field stars of the same mass.”
Abstract: “We find that in the thick disk ($H/r \sim 0.1$) case, a Salpeter population of stars can easily explain the observed metal enrichment”
Abstract: “we also argue that a thin disk ($H/r \lesssim 0.01$) is incompatible with the observed metal enrichment.”
Abstract: “In our model, AGN metallicity scales most strongly with disk thickness, implying a potentially powerful observable diagnostic.”
analysis.research_progress: 提出解释 Mrk 573 金属富集的盘内原位恒星形成模型，并指出 AGN 金属丰度可能成为诊断吸积盘厚度的观测量。

analysis.reason: 与研究组的相对论喷流和黑洞高能观测方向有实质联系：联合 Fe-K 反射谱与 VLBI 喷流准直轮廓，检验高吸积率环境中热内流与喷流发射的几何联系。其价值主要在于中心引擎假设的观测约束和联合诊断方法；研究对象是 AGN，且视界尺度结论依赖外推，尚不能直接证明盘截断触发喷流或 Blandford–Znajek 机制，因此列为 worth_knowing。
analysis.result: 正文报告 XRISM 光谱需要相对论展宽反射分量，物理反射模型给出的光学厚盘内缘为 17.4（+6.3/-6.5）Rg，误差为 1σ；更换为 relxillCp 及改变电子温度得到相近结果。VLBI 喷流轮廓在内侧呈准抛物线形，指数为 0.61±0.07，外侧呈近圆锥形，指数为 1.13±0.04；向黑洞附近外推得到喷流半径不超过约 7 Rg。作者据此提出截断薄盘内部存在热厚流，并支持自旋供能喷流的解释，但热流磁化状态和 BZ 机制未被直接确证。附录报告约 1.2×10^-5 Hz 的边缘显著 QPO 候选，而非稳健探测。
analysis.reading_entry: X-ray Spectral Analysis
analysis.problem: 高吸积率系统通常预期具有难以输运和维持强磁通量的冷薄盘，却仍能产生强相对论喷流；论文研究 3C120 的内盘是否截断，以及盘内缘与喷流基部几何能否为热厚流支持的喷流引擎提供约束。
analysis.method: 联合拟合 XRISM Resolve 和 Xtend 的 3.0–12.0 keV 光谱，分离连续谱、BLR/尘埃环反射和相对论盘反射，使用 C 统计量与 AIC 比较模型，并以 relxillCp 检查反射模型依赖性。分析 GMVA 86 GHz、VLBA 43/15 GHz 和 EAVN 22 GHz 成像，对横向切片作高斯拟合、去卷积测量喷流宽度，再拟合折断幂律并向内外推。附录使用 Xtend 光变的 PSD 和 10000 次红噪声 Monte Carlo 模拟评估候选 QPO。
assumptions: 主反射拟合固定黑洞自旋 a=0.99，将各反射分量倾角绑定，并用单一幂律发射率指数；正文另测试 a=0，得到相同参数和拟合质量。
喷流轮廓换算采用黑洞质量 6.3×10^7 太阳质量和视角 19 度，距离从 86 GHz 射电核起算；视界附近半径来自准抛物线轮廓向内外推。
QPO 显著性模拟假定底层红噪声为简单幂律，并在预先指定的频率搜索窗口内处理多重试验效应。
limits: 喷流视界尺度不是直接分辨测量，而是轮廓外推；本文 VLBI 数据并不适合可靠的核位移测量，作者明确指出多频数据非同时且没有相位参考。
盘内缘远离 ISCO，反射谱对自旋不敏感，不能精确测量自旋；几何约束不足以确证 MAD 状态或 BZ 供能，也不能单凭本文证明截断与喷流启动的因果关系。
QPO 只覆盖约 4–5 个周期，显著性可能依赖噪声模型；作者将其报告为边缘结果，需要更长观测区分复杂红噪声。
在谱测截断半径处计算的测试粒子 Lense–Thirring 频率比候选调制低一个数量级以上；更小半径进动、逆行 MAD 或磁通爆发等解释仍未解决。
citation_leads: Introduction: “Reconciling powerful relativistic jets with such high-accretion-rate environments therefore remains a challenge in high-energy astrophysics.”
X-ray Spectral Analysis: “To examine this structure, we simultaneously fitted the Resolve and Xtend spectra in the 3.0--12.0~keV energy band”

X-ray Spectral Analysis: “Our observations with the X-ray microcalorimeter, Resolve, provide the first high-resolution spectroscopic confirmation of this relativistic line profile, yielding the most robust and precise constraint on the truncation radius to date.”
X-ray Spectral Analysis: “constrains the inner radius of the optically thick accretion disk to $R_{\rm in} = 17.4^{+6.3}_{-6.5}~R_{\rm g}$ ($1\sigma$ confidence level).”

X-ray Timing and PSD Analysis: “While the light curve exhibits a quasi-periodic modulation, we note that only 4--5 cycles were captured, necessitating a cautious interpretation.”

X-ray Timing and PSD Analysis: “While we assumed a simple power-law for the underlying continuum in our simulations, we acknowledge that the significance of this feature could be sensitive to the choice of the noise model.”
X-ray Timing and PSD Analysis: “Given that only a limited number of cycles were covered during the observation, we report this detection as a marginal result.”

analysis.reason: 研究对象是宇宙正午星系的低电离星云发射及元素丰度诊断。虽然使用光电离模型并检验激波解释，但摘要未建立与 FRB/PRS 环境、瞬变周星介质、超新星中心引擎或其他目标高能瞬变方向的实质联系，因此在摘要筛选阶段跳过。
analysis.result: 分析表明，高红移星系的 S2-BPT 诊断需要考虑低于太阳值的硫丰度模式。常规 H II 区模型无法复现样本中约 48% 的 [S II] 和约 55% 的 [O I] 发射；与现有模型比较未发现湍流或激波驱动额外发射的明确证据。作者提出这些发射可能来自 H II 区外的弥散电离气体，其性质可能不同于低红移弥散电离气体。纳入恒星形成区外气体的发射可使 12+log(S/H) 产生最高 0.1 dex 的小偏差。
analysis.reading_entry: Abstract
analysis.problem: 宇宙正午星系中中性及低电离气体的发射能否由常规 H II 区模型解释，硫丰度模式如何影响发射线诊断，以及额外发射的可能来源与丰度测量偏差。
analysis.method: 分析 CECILIA 巡天中 19 个星系的超深 JWST/NIRSpec 光谱，使用 [O I]λ6302 和 [S II]λλ6718,33 发射线、光电离模型模拟器 Cue，并与现有湍流或激波模型进行比较。
limits: 与现有模型比较未发现湍流或激波驱动额外发射的明确证据；摘要没有确定额外发射的物理来源。
弥散电离气体解释被表述为可能性，其性质可能不同于低红移弥散电离气体。
citation_leads: Abstract: “motivate an updated study of neutral and low-ionization emission within Cosmic Noon galaxies.”
Abstract: “we present a new analysis of [O I]λ6302 and [S II]λλ6718,33 in 19 galaxies observed using ultra-deep JWST/NIRSpec spectroscopy as part of the CECILIA survey.”
Abstract: “it is necessary to consider sub-solar abundance patterns in sulfur at high-z when analyzing galaxies on the S2-BPT”

Abstract: “Using the photoionization model emulator Cue, we find that ~48% of observed [S II] and ~55% of observed [O I] emission in CECILIA galaxies cannot be reproduced by conventional HII region models.”
Abstract: “We find no clear evidence for turbulence or shocks driving this excess emission when comparing to existing models.”
Abstract: “this excess emission may originate in diffuse ionized gas outside of H II regions, though its nature may be different than that of low-z DIG.”
Abstract: “including emission from gas outside of star-forming regions can incur a small bias up to 0.1 dex in 12+log(S/H).”

analysis.reason: 研究对象是星系整体 HI 质量与暗物质晕质量的关系及其在星系形成模拟中的表现。摘要未涉及 FRB/PRS 环境、瞬变中心引擎、周星介质相互作用、光电离与色散测量、相对论喷流或致密天体高能观测，与研究组方向无实质联系。
analysis.result: 观测样本显示，旋转支撑盘星系的 HI 质量与暗物质晕质量近似成正比；在 7≤log(M★/M⊙)≤11.5 的恒星质量范围内，log(MHI/M200)≈−1.90，1σ 散布为 0.36 dex。AMIGA 和 GHASP 与此前 SPARC 和 LITTLE THINGS 的关系在统计上相容。相比之下，SIMBA、IllustrisTNG 和 NIHAO 预测该比值依赖恒星质量，并在 M★>10^10 M⊙ 的盘星系中出现转折。
analysis.reading_entry: Abstract
analysis.problem: 检验此前发现的 HI 质量与暗物质晕质量比例关系是否适用于孤立星系及不同隔离程度的星系，并与宇宙学流体动力学模拟预测比较。
analysis.method: 加入 AMIGA 和 GHASP 星系样本，利用高分辨率旋转曲线和红外测光构建质量模型、推导暗物质晕参数，比较不同观测样本的 HI—晕质量关系及模拟预测。
citation_leads: Abstract: “The relation between HI and dark matter (DM) halo masses provides key insights into gas accretion and the regulation of galaxy formation.”

Abstract: “In this work, we extend that analysis by incorporating galaxies from the Analysis of the interstellar Medium in Isolated GAlaxies (AMIGA) sample and from the Gassendi HAlpha survey of SPirals (GHASP).”
Abstract: “well-suited for testing whether the relation found in the previous samples holds in interaction-free galaxies.”
Abstract: “We construct mass models from high-resolution rotation curves and infrared photometry, and derive DM halo parameters.”

Abstract: “We confirm the proportionality between HI and DM halo masses and find a nearly constant HI-mass-to-halo-mass ratio of $\log(M_{HI}/M_{200})=-1.90$ over nearly five orders of magnitude in stellar mass ($7\leq\log(M_{\star}/M_\odot)\leq 11.5$), with a $1σ$ scatter of 0.36 dex.”

Abstract: “The AMIGA and GHASP samples are statistically consistent with the relation previously found for the SPARC and LITTLE THINGS samples, indicating that it is robust across galaxies spanning a broad range of isolation levels.”

Abstract: “In contrast, cosmological hydrodynamic simulations such as SIMBA, IllustrisTNG, and NIHAO predict a dependence on stellar mass, with a break at the high stellar mass end for disc galaxies ($M_{\star}>10^{10}M_{\odot}$).”
analysis.research_progress: 在此前 SPARC 和 LITTLE THINGS 分析基础上纳入 AMIGA 和 GHASP，进一步确认该比例关系在不同隔离程度的星系中保持稳健，并指出其与当前模拟预测的恒星质量依赖性不一致。

analysis.reason: 研究聚焦于天琴座 RR 型变星的距离与金属丰度标定，以及麦哲伦云老年恒星族群的金属丰度分布。摘要未呈现与 FRB/PRS 环境、超新星中心引擎、激波破越、周星介质相互作用或致密天体高能观测的实质联系，因此在本研究组的摘要筛选阶段归为 skip。
analysis.result: 得到新的 PLZ/PWZ 关系，并据此测得大、小麦哲伦云的距离模数分别为 18.47 ± 0.07（统计）± 0.05（系统）mag 和 18.87 ± 0.09（统计）± 0.06（系统）mag。重新标定测光金属丰度关系后，在大麦哲伦云识别出两个不同的基模 RR Lyrae 星族群，小麦哲伦云则仅发现一个。
analysis.reading_entry: Abstract
analysis.problem: 如何利用 RR Lyrae 星的周期、光度及金属丰度关系，精确测量麦哲伦云距离并研究其金属丰度分布。
analysis.method: 结合 OGLE 与 WISE 的光学 V、I 波段和中红外 W1 波段测光，以 Gaia DR3 视差为锚点，使用银河晕场 RR Lyrae 星的光谱金属丰度目录标定经验 PLZ/PWZ 关系；另重新标定测光金属丰度关系，以推导麦哲伦云 RR Lyrae 星的个体 [Fe/H]。
citation_leads: Abstract: “RR Lyrae (RRL) stars, thanks to the existence of their period-luminosity relations, have been widely used as primary standard candles within the Milky Way and the Local Group of galaxies.”

Abstract: “We present in this work the latest empirical RRL period-luminosity-metallicity (PLZ) and period-Wesenheit-metallicity (PWZ) relations combining optical ($V, I$) and mid-infrared data ($W1$) using OGLE and WISE photometry, anchored to Gaia DR3 parallaxes.”
Abstract: “We calibrate these relations with the largest, most complete, and homogeneous catalog of Galactic halo field RRL spectroscopic metallicities.”

Abstract: “These new PLZ/PWZ relations provide distance measurements in remarkable agreement with those derived from eclipsing binaries in the Large and Small Magellanic Clouds (MC): $(m-M)_{0, LMC} = 18.47 \pm 0.07 (stat) \pm 0.05 (sys)$ mag and $(m-M)_{0, SMC} = 18.87 \pm 0.09 (stat) \pm 0.06 (sys)$ mag”
Abstract: “We have also re-calibrated photometric metallicity relations to derive individual [Fe/H] abundances of LMC and SMC RRL stars.”
Abstract: “This allowed us to investigate the metallicity gradient of the MCs and discover two distinct populations of fundamental mode RRL stars in the LMC (only one is instead found in the SMC).”
analysis.research_progress: 提供新的经验 PLZ/PWZ 标定，所得麦哲伦云距离与食双星距离相符；重新标定测光金属丰度关系，并识别出大麦哲伦云的两个不同基模 RR Lyrae 星族群。

analysis.reason: 研究聚焦麦哲伦云中大质量年轻恒星体的碎裂、分子气体外流及致密气体运动学。摘要中的准直双极喷流属于恒星形成语境，没有给出与相对论喷流、高能瞬变、FRB/PRS 环境或超新星周星介质相互作用的实质联系，因此在摘要筛选阶段跳过。
analysis.result: 三个目标呈现不同程度的碎裂：S07 为单个致密源，Lh03 为少数致密源，Lh09 为致密源群。Lh09 中识别出 17 个核候选体，最低测得质量为 2.6 Msun，去投影间距在约 6000 au 处达峰。三个目标均有高速 CO(3–2) 外流，Lh09 中探测到一个核驱动的准直双极喷流。约 1500 au 尺度上的现象与银河系大质量年轻恒星体中的现象定性相似。
analysis.reading_entry: 摘要
analysis.problem: 不同于典型银河系的环境中，大质量恒星形成的碎裂、外流和致密气体运动学是否具有相似的基本过程，以及这些性质如何随源特征和环境变化。
analysis.method: 使用 ALMA band 7 长基线观测研究三个麦哲伦云大质量年轻恒星体，以约 0.03 角秒、对应约 1500 au 的分辨率观测 0.87 mm 连续谱及分子谱线，分析碎裂、外流和速度梯度。
limits: 摘要明确指出源间连续谱形态和致密气体运动学存在显著多样性，需要更大规模的高分辨率巡天才能确定这些性质如何随源特征和环境变化。
citation_leads: Abstract: “The Magellanic Clouds provide an excellent laboratory to study massive star formation beyond typical Galactic environments.”

Abstract: “Using ALMA band 7 long-baseline observations, we present the highest resolution (approximately 0.03", $1500{\rm\:au}$) view to date of three massive young stellar objects (MYSOs) in the Magellanic Clouds”
Abstract: “reveals varying levels of fragmentation, from a single compact source (S07), a few (Lh03), to a cluster of compact sources (Lh09).”
Abstract: “In Lh09, we identified 17 core candidates with lowest measured mass of 2.6 Msun, and their de-projected separations peak around 6000~au.”
Abstract: “All three targets exhibit high velocity CO(3--2) outflows, including detection of a collimated bipolar jet driven by a core in Lh09.”

Abstract: “Taken together, these phenomena observed on $\sim1500$~au scales are qualitatively similar to those seen in Galactic MYSOs, suggesting a degree of universality in the basic processes of massive star formation across different environments.”

Abstract: “Nevertheless, the substantial source-to-source diversity in continuum morphology and dense-gas kinematics motivates larger high-resolution surveys to determine how these properties vary with source characteristics and environment.”
analysis.research_progress: 提供了截至该研究时三个麦哲伦云大质量年轻恒星体的最高分辨率观测，揭示约 1500 au 尺度上的碎裂、外流及气体运动学，并指出它们与银河系同类目标的现象定性相似。

analysis.reason: 摘要研究的是 N159 的近红外恒星族群、年轻恒星体识别及序列恒星形成。虽涉及 H II 区、尘埃与分子气体环境，但未呈现与 FRB/PRS、超新星中心引擎、激波破越、瞬变周星介质相互作用或致密天体高能观测的实质联系，因此在本轮摘要筛选中跳过。
analysis.result: 获得超过 300,000 个点源的近红外测光，探测对应质量低于约 0.1 个太阳质量的恒星，并发现年龄小于 0.5 Myr 的恒星族群证据。通过 Paα 超额识别吸积中的前主序星，通过红外超额识别候选年轻恒星体，其中部分具有水冰吸收。候选年轻恒星体与尘埃丝状结构和分子气体空间相关；N159E 的恒星形成族群更演化，N159W 的恒星形成更新，支持该区域的序列恒星形成情景。
analysis.reading_entry: 摘要
analysis.problem: 研究 N159 的近红外恒星族群及其空间分布是否支持大尺度序列恒星形成情景。
analysis.method: 使用 JWST/NIRCam 十个覆盖 1–4.7 微米的近红外滤光片进行点源测光，构建颜色–星等图和颜色–颜色图以区分恒星族群，利用 Paα 超额及红外超额识别年轻源，并考察候选年轻恒星体与尘埃丝状结构及分子气体的空间关联。
citation_leads: Abstract: “We present the first results from a JWST/NIRCam study of the star-forming region N159, one of the richest H II complexes in the Large Magellanic Cloud.”
Abstract: “We present photometric results of $>$300,000 point sources combining data from ten near-infrared JWST filters spanning 1-4.7 microns.”
Abstract: “We detect sources as faint as $\sim$27 magnitudes at F115W, corresponding to stellar masses reaching below $\sim$0.1 $M_{\odot}$.”

Abstract: “By constructing several color-magnitude and color-color diagrams, we separate young stars from main-sequence and older stars within N159, finding evidence for stellar populations younger than 0.5 Myr.”

Abstract: “Of the young population, we identify accreting, pre-main sequence stars from their Paschen-$α$ (Pa$α$) excess and a population of sources bearing strong infrared (IR) excess, representing candidate young stellar objects (YSOs).”
Abstract: “Within this population, we identify a subpopulation of sources with H$_2$O ice absorption.”
Abstract: “The IR-excess-bearing YSO candidates correlate spatially with dust filaments and molecular gas demonstrating their embedded state.”

Abstract: “The distribution of stellar and candidate YSO populations across N159 reveal more evolved star-forming populations in the N159E region and newer star formation in the N159W region, supporting the sequential star formation scenario for this region.”
analysis.research_progress: 报告 JWST/NIRCam 对 N159 恒星形成区研究的首批结果，提供深度近红外点源测光及年轻族群分类，并以不同子区域的族群空间分布支持序列恒星形成情景。

analysis.reading_entry: Abstract
analysis.problem: 系统搜寻 z>3 的高电离 [Ne V] 发射体，检验其与常规 AGN 诊断的关系及其作为早期黑洞增长示踪指标的作用。
analysis.method: 使用 JWST/NIRSpec PRISM 光谱中的 [Ne V] λ3426，从超过 9,000 个星系中系统选取发射体，并比较其谱线性质、常规 AGN 分类、Chandra 对应体及红移依赖。
limits: 本地低光度、贫金属 [Ne V] 发射系统会低于该搜寻的灵敏度。
独立选取的宽线 AGN 和 little red dots 的 [Ne V] 上限不够深，不能确认整个种群存在 [Ne V] 缺失。
citation_leads: Abstract: “We conduct the first systematic Search for High-Ionization Nebular Emission (SHINE) using [Ne V]$\lambda3426$ in JWST/NIRSpec PRISM spectroscopy at $z>3$.”
Abstract: “From more than 9,000 galaxies, we identify 25 [Ne V] emitters spanning $z=3.059$-$9.444$ and $\log_{10}(L_{\rm [Ne\,V]}/erg\,s^{-1})=40.70$-$42.86$.”
Abstract: “although such low-luminosity systems would fall below our sensitivity.”
Abstract: “The [Ne V] emitters overlap only partly with conventional AGN diagnostics”
Abstract: “[Ne V] upper limits for independently selected broad-line AGNs and little red dots are too shallow to establish a population-wide [Ne V] deficit.”
Abstract: “Six sources have secure Chandra counterparts, showing that X-ray weakness is not universal among luminous [Ne V] emitters.”
Abstract: “The observed incidence of luminous [Ne V] emission shows no significant evolution over $z>3$”

Abstract: “The high [Ne V] luminosities and hard line ratios favor black-hole accretion as the dominant power source, establishing [Ne V] emission as a complementary probe of early black-hole growth.”

analysis.reading_entry: Abstract
analysis.problem: 将 SOHO/MDI 低分辨率视向磁图超分辨率重建为 SDO/HMI 高分辨率视向磁图，以支持异构空间仪器间的一致分析和太阳磁场演化的长期研究。
analysis.method: 采用由 ESRGAN 预训练权重初始化的改进 RRDBNet；通过逐图诊断分析识别图像复杂度与重建误差的关系，构建带不确定性估计的三专家自适应分层集成，使用加权随机采样训练，并在推断时由基于输入图像统计量的轻量路由器选择专家网络。
citation_leads: Abstract: “Single-image super-resolution of Sun's photospheric magnetograms enables consistent analysis across heterogeneous space-based instruments and supports long-term studies of solar magnetic field evolution.”

Abstract: “We address the super-resolution task from SOHO/MDI (low-resolution) to SDO/HMI (high-resolution) line-of-sight (LOS) magnetograms using a modified RRDBNet architecture initialized by ESRGAN pretrained weights.”
Abstract: “Through systematic per-image diagnostic analysis, we identify image complexity as the dominant predictor of reconstruction errors.”

Abstract: “To exploit this finding, we introduce an adaptive stratified specialist ensemble (SSE) of three specialist networks with uncertainty estimation, where each specialist network is trained by images from three different complexity strata using a weighted random sampling strategy.”
Abstract: “During inference, a lightweight router based on input image statistics assigns each test image to the appropriate specialist network.”
Abstract: “Our experimental results demonstrate the good performance of the proposed ensemble and its superiority over closely related methods.”

analysis.reason: 研究聚焦轴子冷却对天琴座RR型变星周期—光度关系的影响及球状星团M3的零点标定，与本组关注的高能瞬变、FRB/PRS环境、超新星中心引擎、激波及致密天体高能观测无实质联系。
analysis.result: 轴子通过电子耦合在红巨星分支阶段冷却核心，使点火时核心质量增大，进而提高水平分支恒星的光度，将天琴座RR型变星周期—光度关系的零点系统性移向更亮的星等。当α₂₆≡10²⁶g_ae²/4π=0.5时，预测的零点偏移与当前M3绝对零点标定的不确定度相当。
analysis.reading_entry: 摘要
analysis.problem: 轴子对天琴座RR型变星周期—光度关系有何影响，以及这种影响相对于M3当前零点标定精度的大小。
analysis.method: 采用针对M3年龄和成分的恒星演化及脉动计算，模拟其天琴座RR型变星群体，并将合成的K_s波段周期—光度关系与观测比较。
limits: 在α₂₆=0.5的情形下，预测的轴子诱导零点偏移与当前M3绝对零点标定的不确定度相当。
citation_leads: Abstract: “We investigate the impact of axions on the period-luminosity relation (PLR) of RR Lyrae stars.”

Abstract: “During the red giant branch phase, emission through the electron coupling cools the core, increasing its mass at ignition. The larger core produces more luminous horizontal-branch stars, systematically shifting the zero point of the RR Lyrae PLR toward brighter magnitudes.”

Abstract: “We model the RR Lyrae population of the globular cluster M3 using stellar evolution and pulsation calculations tailored to its age and composition, and compare the resulting synthetic $K_s$-band PLR with observations.”
Abstract: “For $α_{26}\equiv 10^{26}g_{ae}^2/4π=0.5$, the axion-induced shift in the predicted PLR is comparable to the current uncertainty in the absolute M3 zero-point calibration.”
analysis.research_progress: 通过M3恒星群体的演化与脉动建模，量化轴子冷却引起的K_s波段周期—光度关系零点偏移，并将其与当前绝对零点标定的不确定度比较。

analysis.reason: 直接关联 FRB 重复性、宿主环境与色散测量：将重复探测选择效应纳入多望远镜种群联合拟合，能用于检验“所有 FRB 均会重复”的工作假设，并约束源演化及磁星形成率解释。其价值在于方法与限制的增量，而非仅在于作者所称的首次分析。研读时必须区分条件性模型结论与对单一种群假设的独立验证。
analysis.result: 正文报告重复率分布斜率 R_gamma=-2.20（+0.12/-0.22），最高重复率 R_max≳1 d^-1，最低重复率写作 R_min=-4.23（+1.10/-1.74）d^-1。最低率的负数写法存在表示歧义：附录测试参数采用 log10 R_min，但主文结果未明确标注对数，不能将该负数直接理解为物理重复率。三个重复参数之间相关，但与其他种群参数未显示强相关。更新的源演化参数 n_sfr=0.76±0.28，与追踪宇宙恒星形成史相容。作者报告 CHIME catalogue 1 的 DM 分布检验 p=0.9，但未参与拟合的 catalogue 2 为 p=1.8×10^-4，因此不能把后者概括为统计上通过模型检验。假设所有源均重复时，正文给出 log10 C_r=-3.9（+1.5/-0.9），密度单位为 Mpc^-3；再假定约 10^4 年的磁星场衰减时间，推得形成率约 1–400 Gpc^-3 yr^-1。
analysis.reading_entry: Model limitations
analysis.problem: 忽略重复性会如何偏置 FRB 的红移—DM 种群推断？在统一内禀种群假设下，能否同时解释多望远镜观测、重复源与表观非重复源的比例，并约束重复率分布、能量分布、宿主 DM 和源演化？
analysis.method: 在 zDM 框架内，以超过宿主系 10^39 erg、1 GHz 带宽阈值的重复率建立幂律分布，联合拟合其上下界、斜率及其他种群参数。对已知每视场驻留时间的 CHIME 和 ASKAP ICS 分别建立单次探测源与重复源的 P(z,DM) 网格，并结合探测 SNR 和每个重复源的爆发次数似然。其他巡天不使用重复统计。采用红移完整性及银河纬度切割减少选择偏差；ASKAP ICS 使用实际波束位置，并以有效驻留时间和有效频率近似变化的观测配置。主分析保留重复巡天所需的计数/比例信息，不纳入非重复巡天的 P(N)；附录比较加入后者的结果。MCMC 使用 40 个 walkers、2000 步和 500 步 burn-in。
assumptions: 所有 FRB 来自同一内禀种群且本质上均会重复；表观重复源与非重复源共享全局能量分布、源演化及谱行为。
阈值以上的重复率服从具有最小值、最大值和斜率的幂律分布；给定固定重复率后，重复源的爆发计数按泊松过程处理。
宿主关联概率高于 90% 的关联按 100% 处理，低于 90% 的按 0% 处理。
ASKAP 变化的驻留时间与频率配置可近似为 123 个视场、每场 3.66 天及 1.272 GHz 的有效配置。
将源密度换算为形成率时，采用磁星场约 10^4 年的衰减时间。
limits: 单一种群假设不是分析证明的结论；正文指出重复源与非重复源在宽度、谱行为及形态上存在已观测差异。
固定重复率的泊松模型未包含活动窗口和非泊松聚集；这些效应会影响给定观测时段内的爆发次数。
总观测时间存在跨巡天不一致；非重复巡天 P(N) 的加入主要改变 alpha，相关观测时间系统误差未体现在所报不确定度中。正文对“排除 P(N)”的概述与后续保留重复巡天 P(N) 的说明不完全一致，应以后者及附录对照理解。
CHIME catalogue 2 未参与拟合，因为重复源身份不够稳健；其 DM 分布的 KS 检验 p=1.8×10^-4，与结论章节声称两目录均有良好一致性的表述存在张力。DM 分布检验未传播银河 ISM 与 halo 贡献的不确定度。
R_max 没有数据给出的上限；R_min 在 R_gamma≈-2 的区域存在延伸至先验边界以外的低端尾部。主文最低重复率的负数及单位写法存在对数表示歧义。
MCMC 步数受计算成本限制，作者明确希望采用更多步数；正文未提供足以独立确认链收敛的诊断。
citation_leads: Introduction: “In particular, FRB population studies help constrain the energetics, evolution and host-environment properties of FRBs, while also allowing us to study the gas through which the signal propagates.”

Methodology: “The repetition model assumes all FRBs are derived from a single population and hence can be described by a single set of population parameters. This implicitly assumes all FRBs are intrinsic repeaters.”

Constraining repetition parameters: “We additionally calculate $P(N_{\mathrm{b,obs}})$ for each repeater, where $N_{\mathrm{b,obs}}$ is the number of bursts detected from a specific repeater. Again, this is modelled as a Poisson process, which is an oversimplification.”

Sample cuts: “we implicitly make the assumption that all associations with probability of association $P(O) > 90\%$ actually have $P(O) = 100\%$ and all associations with $P(O) < 90\%$ have $P(O)=0\%$.”

ASKAP data: “To work around this issue, we approximate all observations with a characteristic frequency of 1.272\,GHz. We also use a single effective pointing time ($T_{\mathrm{eff}}$) of 3.66 days over an effective number of 123 fields.”

Results: “The results were generated using 40 walkers running for 2000 steps with a burn-in of 500. Ideally, we would have a significantly larger number of steps, but it is currently not computationally feasible”

Predicted number of repeaters and non-repeaters: “As such, for this analysis we do not include $P(N)$ for Murriyang (Parkes), \flyseye{} or FAST and only include information of $P(N)$ in the repeater surveys, which effectively determines the ratio of repeaters to non-repeaters.”
Repetition parameters: “From this, we constrain \Rgamma{}$=$\Rgammaval{}, \Rmin{}$=$\Rminval{} and \Rmax{}$\gtrsim$\Rmaxval{}.”
Repetition parameters: “Excluding themselves, the three repetition parameters do not show strong correlations with any other parameters.”
Repetition parameters: “This tail comes from the region of the parameter space where \Rgamma{}$\approx -2$, and the lower limit of \Rmin{} is effectively unconstrained in this region.”

Repetition parameters: “Magnetar fields are expected to decay on timescales of order $10^{4}$\,yr \citep{Colpi2000}, and under this assumption we predict birth rates of $1 \sim 400$\,Gpc$^{-3}$\,yr$^{-1}$.”

analysis.reason: 与研究组的相对论喷流及黑洞中心引擎方向有实质联系：将外部磁场输运、吸积流面密度与 Blandford–Znajek（BZ）喷流功率联系起来，用 M87 的观测约束检验 MAD/SANE 状态。适合作为喷流磁通量与引擎状态诊断的理论参考，但不直接研究高能瞬变、FRB 或超新星，故列为 worth_knowing。
analysis.result: 在作者采用的吸积流模型、参数及瞬时喷流功率 P_jet=3.2×10^43 erg/s 下，计算要求 M87 内区进入磁阻塞盘（MAD）状态；外缘数百 μG 的磁场被放大至视界附近数百 G。作者指出，若喷流功率显著低于约 1.75×10^43 erg/s，则允许 SANE 状态。这是依赖喷流功率估计及磁场输运模型的条件性结论，而非直接观测确认。
analysis.reading_entry: Discussion
analysis.problem: M87 的吸积流是否必须处于 MAD 状态，还是 SANE 也能在受光谱及法拉第旋转测量约束的吸积率下产生所估计的喷流功率？
analysis.method: 采用既有多波段光谱与法拉第旋转测量约束的内区吸积率，构造含外流质量损失的 ADAF；用磁力与有效径向引力的比较定义 MAD 条件。求解稳态磁场平流—扩散方程，并迭代磁场与含磁外流的吸积流结构；将 ISCO 磁场通过假定的增强因子换算到视界，计算 BZ 功率，再与既有射电核心位移模型估计的瞬时喷流功率比较。
assumptions: 大尺度磁场来自外部弱垂直磁场，由 ADAF 向内平流，同时发生湍流扩散。
采用牛顿框架计算至 ISCO；对快速旋转黑洞，取 B_H=f_B B_isco，f_B≈6，以描述 ISCO 至视界之间的磁场增强。
将圆化半径作为 ADAF 外缘，基准取 R_out≈0.1R_A≈8.37×10^4 R_g；MAD 区内假设无质量外流、吸积率不随半径变化。
基准参数为黑洞质量 6.5×10^9 M_sun、自旋 a=0.9、黏滞参数 α=0.3、f_Ω=0.9、H/R=0.5；多数计算取文中定义的磁 Prandtl 数 P_m=η_m/ν=0.5。
limits: MAD/SANE 判定对喷流功率测量敏感；采用的是既有辐射喷流模型给出的瞬时功率，而非本文新增的直接测量。
牛顿模型不能描述 ISCO 与视界之间的 plunging region 动力学，未进行完整广义相对论计算；视界磁场依赖假定的增强因子。
内区面密度来自采用 SANE 模型的既有光谱拟合；作者认为 MAD/SANE 光谱差异不可观测地区分，因此不会影响主要结论，但本文没有重新进行 MAD 光谱拟合。
citation_leads: Introduction: “The jet power is then calculated with derived field strength at the BH horizon, which is confronted with the jet power estimated from observations. The accretion state in M87 is therefore revealed.”

Formation of magnetic field in the ADAF: “In this work, we assume that an external vertical field is advected inwards by the ADAF, while the field will diffuse out at the same time, which is described by the magnetic diffusivity in a turbulent accretion flow.”
Blandford-Znajek jet power: “For a rapidly rotating BH in M87, we adopt $f_{\rm B}\sim 6$ ($B_{\rm H}=f_{\rm B} B_{\rm isco}$) in our calculations.”

Blandford-Znajek jet power: “It is worth noting that our model is formulated in a Newtonian framework, which is unable to describe the dynamics of the accretion flow in the plunge region between the ISCO and the BH horizon. The full general relativistic (GR) calculations are beyond the scope of this work.”
Accretion Rate of the ADAF: “We adopt the circularization radius as the outer radius of the ADAF, $R_{\rm out} \simeq 0.1R_{\rm A} \simeq 8.37\times 10^4~R_{\rm g}$.”
Accretion Rate of the ADAF: “$\dot{M}(R \leq R_{\rm m})=\dot{M}(R_{\rm m})$, corresponding to no mass outflow within the MAD zone, in the region of  $R < R_{\rm m}$.”

Results: “In this work, we adopt $M_{\rm BH}=6.5\times10^9 M_{\odot}$, the BH spin parameter $a = 0.9$ for M87, the $\alpha$-viscosity parameter $\alpha = 0.3$ \citep{2016ApJ...830....6F}, $f_\Omega=0.9$ and a typical value of $H/R = 0.5$ in the calculations of the magnetic field strength in the ADAF.”
Results: “We adopt $P_{\rm m} = 0.5$ in most of our calculations, but also explore how the results will be affected by the value of $P_{\rm m}$.”
Formation of magnetic field in the ADAF: “where the magnetic Prandtl number $P_{\rm m}\equiv \eta_{\rm m}/\nu$.”
Results: “We find that the final solution is available usually after several  iterations.”

Discussion: “Our results show that the field is substantially enhanced in the accretion flow (from several hundred $\mu \rm G$ at $R_{\rm out}$ to hundreds G at $R_{\rm h}$, see Figure \ref{fig:BZ}) .”

Discussion: “In this work, we adopt the jet power estimated with a radiative jet model \citep[][]{2015MNRAS.451..927Z}, which is instant jet power,  and is more suitable for our present investigation than those estimates of long-time averaged jet power”

Discussion: “It is found that, in order to produce the observed jet power $P_{\rm jet}=3.2\times 10^{43}~\rm erg~s^{-1}$, the accretion flow in M87 must be magnetically arrested (see Figure \ref{fig:P_Bz}).”

Discussion: “We note that our conclusion depends sensitively on the measurement of jet power. If the jet power is significantly lower than $\sim 1.75 \times 10^{43} \rm erg~s^{-1}$, a SANE disc is allowed in M87. Thus, accurate measurement of instant jet power is the key point to resolve this problem.”

Discussion: “The structure (i.e., the surface density) of the disc in the inner region is derived with the spectral fitting, in which a SANE model is adopted \citep{2016ApJ...830....6F}. We believe it will not affect our main conclusion on MAD, because the detailed calculations show the spectral difference between MAD and SANE models is observationally indistinguishable \citep{2019ApJ...887..167X}.”

analysis.result: 对于稀薄晕且 w≠−1 的情形，光环角频率与 Lyapunov 指数获得相同的领先阶引力红移，从而使准正常模频率的实部和虚部发生普适偏移；偏移幅度取决于晕结构与径向压强。w=−1 时，领先阶共同红移因子消失，修正进一步受黑洞与晕尺度层级抑制，普适关系被打破，主导贡献由内晕轮廓控制。标量场准正常模数值计算支持解析 eikonal 结果。

analysis.method: 用具有广义密度轮廓及常数径向状态方程参数 w 的各向异性流体描述暗物质晕，构造静态球对称时空，解析研究光环及 eikonal 准正常模修正，并数值计算标量场准正常模谱进行检验。
assumptions: 暗物质晕由各向异性流体描述，采用广义密度轮廓和常数径向状态方程参数 w。
所构造的时空为静态、球对称。
limits: 摘要中的共同领先阶红移结论限定于稀薄晕且 w≠−1 的情形。

citation_leads: Abstract: “We investigate the black-hole quasinormal mode redshifts induced by a galactic dark-matter halo with nonvanishing radial pressure.”
Abstract: “The halo is described by an anisotropic fluid with a generalized density profile and a constant radial equation-of-state parameter $w$.”
Abstract: “We construct the corresponding static, spherically symmetric spacetime and study the resulting corrections to the unstable light ring and quasinormal-mode spectrum.”

Abstract: “For dilute halos and $w\neq -1$, the light-ring angular frequency and Lyapunov exponent acquire the same leading-order gravitational redshift, implying a universal shift of the real and imaginary parts of the quasinormal frequencies.”
Abstract: “The magnitude of this effect depends on both the halo structure and the radial pressure.”

Abstract: “This universal redshift relation holds not only in the case of $w=0$ that has been discovered in the literature but also in a much wider scenario, supporting its importance in black hole spectroscopy.”

Abstract: “On the other hand, the case $w=-1$ is qualitatively different: the factor that corresponds to the leading common redshift vanishes, the corrections are further suppressed by the hierarchy between the black-hole and halo scales, and the universal relation is broken, with the dominant contribution controlled by the inner halo profile.”
Abstract: “Our numerical computations of scalar-field quasinormal mode spectra confirm the analytic eikonal results.”

analysis.reason: 对相对论喷流源的伽马射线总体研究有辅助效用：提供 Fermi blazar 红移分布估计及保留暗弱源的多模型方法，可作为总体与演化研究的统计输入。但正文不直接研究喷流动力学、瞬变机制、FRB/PRS、超新星中心引擎或中微子，且单源不确定性尚未得到严格校准，因此建议了解方法与限制，而非优先精读。
analysis.result: 作者为1590个无已测红移的 blazar 构建了经验预测分布目录。35种模型表现接近；在建模变量 p=1/(1+z) 下，正文报告平均 RMSE 范围为0.1291–0.1472、相关系数约0.7。叠加单源 PDF 后，作者报告恢复了已知红移样本的双峰结构，但分布宽度偏窄、极端红移尾部恢复不足。BCU 分布的双高斯经验拟合给出约48.6%的 BLL-like 与51.4%的 FSRQ-like 权重，不能视为确定的物理分类。尤其需要注意：名义99.73%概率区间仅覆盖约65%的已知真值。
analysis.reading_entry: Conclusion and discussion
analysis.problem: 约半数伽马射线 blazar 缺少红移；既有机器学习点估计精度不足，缺失特征清洗又会排除大量暗弱源。论文试图在保留这些源的同时，用多模型预测构建单源及总体红移分布，并描述模型间预测差异。
analysis.method: 将4LAC-DR3高银纬样本与4FGL-DR4交叉匹配，得到3333个 blazar，采用40个特征。可处理缺失值的模型使用未插补数据，其他模型采用KNN插补，并以MICE作敏感性比较。对1743个已知红移源按3:1划分训练与测试集，以100次随机划分比较35种回归模型；后续分布分析采用seed=123的参考划分。在 p=1/(1+z) 空间，将35个模型预测作为经验样本，用高斯核KDE和Scott带宽构建单源PDF、众数、中位数及99.73%概率区间，再叠加平均PDF研究总体，并用高斯混合模型描述BCU分布。不将源类别作为输入特征。
assumptions: 将不同回归模型的预测视为独立红移估计，并把这些离散预测作为某个连续预测分布的样本。
不预设整体预测分布为高斯分布；采用非参数KDE描述模型预测的经验分布。
limits: 经验模型集成PDF不是正式校准的贝叶斯后验，也不提供认知不确定性与偶然不确定性的严格分解。
名义99.73%概率区间仅覆盖约65%的已知真值；不宜把该区间直接当作具有99.73%频率覆盖率的红移置信区间。
极端红移训练源稀少，预测向中间值收缩；总体预测分布偏窄，不能完整恢复真实分布尾部。
已知红移训练样本与待预测暗弱源存在观测选择及类别组成差异，限制对目标总体的泛化；保留缺失特征源并不等于消除了选择偏差。
BCU双高斯与三高斯拟合均只是经验参数化，不构成存在独立物理子群的确定证据。

analysis.reading_entry: Abstract
analysis.problem: 研究不同理论方法描述 $^{9}\mathrm{Be}(p,α)^{6}\mathrm{Li}$ 反应低能 S(E) 因子的适用性与物理含义，以及其对天体物理反应率计算的影响。
analysis.method: 对 Wen 等人报告的裸核 Trojan Horse Method（THM）数据进行系统分析，采用多项式拟合、双 Breit–Wigner 模型和 R-matrix 形式体系，并比较这些方法。
citation_leads: Abstract: “The $^{9}\mathrm{Be}(p,α)^{6}\mathrm{Li}$ reaction is a destruction process for $^{9}\text{Be}$ in stars and the Big Bang.”
Abstract: “In this work, the bare-nucleus THM data reported by Wen \textit{et al.} are systematically analyzed using polynomial fitting, a double Breit--Wigner model, and the $R$-matrix formalism.”

Abstract: “The applicability and physical implications of these theoretical approaches in describing the low-energy $S(E)$ factor of the $^{9}\mathrm{Be}(p,α)^{6}\mathrm{Li}$ reaction are investigated and compared.”

Abstract: “Since the THM data have been incorporated into the NACRE II reaction-rate compilation, leading to improved accuracy in reaction-rate evaluations, the refined theoretical analysis presented here provides further insight into the underlying reaction dynamics and establishes a more reliable foundation for stellar reaction-rate calculations.”
analysis.research_progress: 在既有 THM 数据已纳入 NACRE II 反应率汇编的基础上，进一步开展多模型理论分析，以深化对反应动力学的认识并支持更可靠的恒星反应率计算。

analysis.reading_entry: Abstract
analysis.problem: 能否构建同时适用于球状星团（GC）和超致密矮星系（UCD）的统一距离估计关系，以及 UCD 混入和 GC 尺寸如何影响 GCVD 距离估计。
analysis.method: 结合银河系及 M31 的 GC 与文献中的 UCD，利用标度关系随动力学质量的过渡，研究绝对星等—对数动力学质量平面中的双线性距离关系，并检查 UCD 和 GC 尺寸对 GCVD 距离的影响。
limits: 将 GCVD 直接应用于 UCD 存在约 33% 的系统性距离低估。
双线性关系的单个对象距离不确定度约为 30–35%（0.12–0.16 dex）。
citation_leads: Abstract: “we investigate the possibility of a unified distance estimation relation applicable to both GCs and UCDs.”
Abstract: “we exploit the transition between scaling relations with dynamical mass, using the Milky Way and M31 GCs alongside literature UCDs.”
Abstract: “Additionally, we look at the influence of UCDs, and of GC size, on GCVD-derived distances.”
Abstract: “Using the GCVD for UCDs gives a systematic distance underestimation of $\sim$33 per cent, but a cut to select UCDs with GC-like sizes can eliminate this bias.”

Abstract: “Using the bilinear relation formed by the GCs and UCDs in the absolute magnitude - log dynamical mass plane for distance estimation yields per-object distance uncertainties of $\sim$30-35 per cent (0.12-0.16 dex).”
Abstract: “Applied to the dwarf galaxy NGC1052-DF2, whose distance is strongly debated, the relation returns 19.1 $\pm$ 4.3 Mpc, consistent with literature values.”

analysis.result: TNG50 中 z=3 的 45 个大质量星系中心结构普遍扁平、由旋转支撑且 Sérsic 指数较低（n ≲ 1），主要为核盘和核棒而非核球。这些结构在富气体致密化过程中形成，直到 z ≲ 1 才转变为球状、速度弥散主导的系统，而扩展恒星盘在此之前已形成。
analysis.reading_entry: 摘要
analysis.problem: 高红移星系中心区域的形态与动力学结构，以及大质量星系是否可以在尚未形成显著中心球状结构时建立扩展恒星盘。
analysis.method: 研究 TNG50 模拟中 z=3 的 45 个大质量星系的质量完备样本，采用双 Sérsic 轮廓分解、等密度椭圆拟合、内禀三维形状测量和恒星运动学分析，并追踪中心结构的演化。
citation_leads: Abstract: “The morphology of the central regions of high-redshift galaxies remains relatively unexplored, while recent case studies suggest that giant disks can emerge without first developing a prominent central spheroid.”
Abstract: “Here, we investigate the inner structures of a mass-complete sample of 45 massive galaxies at $z=3$ in the TNG50 simulation.”

Abstract: “Through double-Sérsic profile decomposition, isodensity ellipse fitting, intrinsic three-dimensional shape measurements, and stellar kinematics, we find that these central structures are ubiquitously flattened and rotation-supported with low Sérsic indices ($n \lesssim 1$).”
Abstract: “This indicates that the central regions are predominantly nuclear disks and bars rather than bulges.”

Abstract: “Tracking their evolution, we show that these nuclear disks and bars emerge during gas-rich compaction and do not transform into spheroidal and dispersion-dominated systems until $z \lesssim 1$, before which extended stellar disks have already developed.”
Abstract: “Our results suggest that massive disks can assemble around rotation-supported centers and bulge-deficient massive galaxies may be a common outcome of galaxy evolution.”
analysis.research_progress: 将近期个例研究所提示的无显著中心球状结构的大盘形成路径，扩展到 TNG50 中的质量完备样本分析；提出大质量盘可以围绕旋转支撑的中心组装，缺乏核球的大质量星系可能是星系演化的常见结果。

analysis.result: 所有模型均出现恒星碰撞，碰撞比例从圆轨道、等质量双星模型的约 7% 到观测驱动的 Moe2017 分布模型的约 0.2%。作者估计，两种指定双星种群模型在 10^6、10^8、10^9 Msun 黑洞周围对应的 LSST 可探测碰撞率分别约为每年 8,600/3,000、330/150、3.5/2.8 次。
analysis.reading_entry: 摘要
analysis.problem: 银河中心黑洞附近双星遭遇能否产生恒星碰撞，以及碰撞比例、碰撞性质和可探测事件率如何随黑洞质量及双星参数分布变化。
analysis.method: 使用蒙特卡洛模拟建立双星与质量为 10^5–10^10 Msun 的银河中心黑洞遭遇的种群统计；采用三体程序 Multistar 中实现的后牛顿 Einstein-Infeld-Hoffmann 方程，对六种黑洞质量及十种双星参数分布的每种组合模拟 100,000 个模型；结合经验损失锥率和本地黑洞质量函数估计 LSST 可探测事件率。
citation_leads: Abstract: “Using Monte Carlo simulations, we model the population statistics of encounters of such binaries with galactic central black holes (BHs) of mass 10^5-10^{10} Msun”

Abstract: “We use the post-Newtonian Einstein-Infeld-Hoffmann (EIH) equations as implemented in the three-body code Multistar. We simulate 100,000 models each for six BH masses and 10 different binary parameter distributions.”

Abstract: “We find that stellar collisions occur in all models, with collision fractions ranging from ~7% for circular, equal-mass binaries to ~0.2% for the observationally motivated Moe2017 binary distribution.”

Abstract: “Using empirical loss-cone rates and the local BH mass function, we estimate detectable LSST collision rates of ~8,600 and ~3,000 events per year for our Kroupa mass function, Opik's law, inclined orbit model and our MS17 model, respectively, around 10^6 Msun BHs; ~330 and ~150 events per year around 10^8 Msun BHs; and ~3.5 and ~2.8 events per year around 10^9 Msun BHs.”

Abstract: “These results suggest that binary stellar collisions around HMBHs represent a potentially observable population of nuclear transients that may contribute to the growing sample of ambiguous nuclear transients detected by wide-field optical surveys.”
analysis.research_progress: 量化了不同黑洞质量和双星参数分布下的恒星碰撞比例，并估计其 LSST 可探测事件率，提出超大质量黑洞附近双星碰撞可能构成可观测的核区瞬变种群。

analysis.result: 给定正文摘要报告：光滑测试及解析球对称吸积测试总体呈约二阶收敛；刻意匹配离散设置的若干 FP64 测试与 AthenaK 达到舍入误差量级的一致性；分裂单极测试得到趋近 Ω_F/Ω_H=1/2 的场线角速度及向外电磁能流；SANE 测试形成盘—冕—极向漏斗并保持活跃吸积。但三维分辨率序列仅覆盖 0≤t≤2000 t_g，不能据此认定长期湍流统计收敛。
analysis.reading_entry: Fixed-spacetime GRMHD verification
analysis.problem: 如何在均匀及静态细化网格上验证固定时空 GRMHD 数值实现，并为移动激波等不连续解选择合适的比较指标，而不是要求激波处逐点收敛。
analysis.method: 以 Parthenon/Kokkos 为基础，共享有限体积 Godunov 流体内核，采用面中心约束输运、原始变量恢复和一阶通量修正；将几何接口与流体求解器分离，分别验证 CKS 按需几何和 MKS 预存几何路径。验证包括光滑解收敛、匹配与原生算法的跨代码比较、球对称吸积、分裂单极及 SANE 吸积；不连续解比较波序、平台态和局部范数，湍流比较形态及积分诊断。
assumptions: 采用预设定常背景度规；定常度规满足 ∂₀gκλ=0，相应能量几何源项为零。
limits: 数值相对论、辐射输运及耦合 Einstein–GRMHD 系统不在本文范围内。
本文网格验证范围限于均匀网格和静态细化网格。
三维 SANE 分辨率序列限于 0≤t≤2000 t_g；二维及三维测试均不能支持长期湍流统计结论。

analysis.reason: 研究对象是太阳活动区的磁通绳喷发、日冕物质抛射及日冕暗化，重点在于检验暗化对磁通绳足点的示踪能力。给定摘要未体现与 FRB/PRS 环境、超新星中心引擎、激波破越、周星介质相互作用或致密天体高能观测等研究方向的实质联系。
analysis.result: 模拟再现了观测磁通绳的形成、演化和喷发，以及喷发期间的足点迁移；模拟足点位置与日冕暗化位置吻合较好，面积和磁通量总体一致。南侧暗化表现为移动的磁通绳暗化，北侧暗化则收缩并被耀斑带快速闭合。
analysis.reading_entry: Abstract
analysis.problem: 对于 AR 12975 在 2022 年 3 月 28 日发生的 M4 耀斑与 CME 事件，观测日冕暗化能在多大程度上示踪喷发磁通绳的真实足点，以及这些观测特征与数据驱动磁摩擦模拟中的磁通绳演化是否一致。
analysis.method: 结合多波段 SDO/AIA 观测和随时间演化的数据驱动磁摩擦模拟；通过强度阈值、最小强度图及针对困难区域的梯度引导区域生长算法识别暗化；使用扭转与 squashing factor 的组合指标提取模拟中的磁通绳，并比较足点位置、面积和磁通量。
limits: 暗化与模拟足点比较中的差异主要来自探测限制和事件复杂性。
北侧足点区域存在预先偏低的强度，且暗化快速收缩，使观测识别尤其困难。
citation_leads: Abstract: “We aim to investigate the M4 flare and CME event on 28 March 2022 in AR 12975 to determine how well observed coronal dimmings trace the footpoints of an erupting MFR.”
Abstract: “We combined multiwavelength SDO/AIA observations with a time-dependent data-driven magnetofrictional simulation of the AR.”

Abstract: “We identified coronal dimmings using intensity-thresholding and minimum-intensity maps. For challenging regions we used a tailored region growth algorithm from strong gradients. We extracted MFR structures in the simulation using a combined twist and squashing factor metric.”
Abstract: “The simulation reproduces the formation, evolution, and eruption of the observed MFR whose footpoints migrate during the eruption. The footpoints match well with the dimming location.”
Abstract: “The southern dimming shows characteristics of a moving flux rope dimming, while the northern dimming behaves as a shrinking flux rope dimming that is rapidly closed by the flare ribbons.”

Abstract: “Quantitative comparisons of area and magnetic flux show good overall agreement between simulated footpoints and observed dimmings, with discrepancies mainly arising from detection limitations and event complexity.”
Abstract: “The dimmings at the northern footpoint region is particularly challenging in observations due to pre-existing low intensities and its fast shrinkage.”
analysis.research_progress: 针对一个具体太阳喷发事件，定量比较了观测暗化与模拟磁通绳足点的面积和磁通量，得到总体较好的一致性，并识别了足点迁移及南北两侧不同的暗化演化行为。

analysis.result: 正文报告 B、V、R 三个波段均存在本征变异，B 波段振幅最大；多个颜色—星等关系呈显著的越亮越蓝（BWB）趋势，VBO 相关检验报告 p < 10^-4。正文采用 ICCF 得到 V–R 质心时延 0.01^{+3.77}_{-2.23} 天，即误差范围内无显著延迟。作者将这些现象解释为与喷流同步辐射及高能电子加速相容，而非唯一确定这些机制。
analysis.reading_entry: textbfCross-Correlation Analysis
analysis.problem: 补充 1ES 0647+250 在 2020 年活动期、日尺度中间时间尺度上的多波段光学变异信息，研究变异的波长依赖、颜色演化和带间时延及其喷流物理含义。
analysis.method: 合并 VBO 的 B、V、R 差分孔径测光与 ZTF 的 g、r 档案光变；对不同系统施加常数偏移并进行银河系消光校正。通过扣除测光误差方差估计本征变异振幅，使用 Lomb–Scargle 周期图拟合 PSD 幂律，构造颜色—星等图并进行线性回归和 Pearson 检验，以 ICCF 配合 FR/RSS 蒙特卡洛估计 V–R 时延及误差，另计算对数时延分箱的一阶结构函数。
assumptions: 银河系消光校正采用 R_V = 3.1 的消光律。
PSD 拟合假定 P(f) ∝ f^{-β}。

analysis.problem: 气球射电探测器在单一高空位置观测空气簇射时，脉冲来向不能唯一确定簇射轴和离轴观测角，因而信号幅度不能单独确定初级宇宙线能量。论文研究如何为掠大气直接事件及经冰面反射的下行事件重建能量，并量化几何、指向、初级质量、频段和噪声带来的误差。
analysis.method: 将射电幅度谱拟合为A(f)=A₀ exp[γ(f−f₀)]，利用谱斜率γ对离轴角的依赖，把幅度校准至最大相干位置，再通过能量标度关系估计初级能量。依据载荷位置、脉冲来向、平均X_max及切伦科夫照亮条件筛选兼容几何，对多个几何的重建能量取平均。直接事件使用ZHAireS-RASPASS模拟；反射事件在ZHAireS中逐粒子轨迹求球面反射点，施加Fresnel系数、散焦振幅修正和传播时延，并以模拟事件及注入高斯噪声进行验证。
assumptions: 最佳情形验证假定辐射入射角和初级宇宙线质量完全已知，且没有噪声。
limits: 约8–11%的分辨率属于理想模拟条件，不能直接视为实际载荷在未知质量、有限指向精度及环境噪声下的性能。

analysis.result: 在固定质量、距离和倾角时，牛顿 diskbb 模型得到的内半径约为 1.7 ± 0.3 R_g，与高自旋 Kerr 黑洞的 ISCO 相符。相对论模型并未普遍改善拟合：kerrd 和固定倾角的 kerrbb 拟合变差，bhspec 在释放倾角后拟合改善但得到的自旋和倾角与既有结果不一致；slimdisk 和 superkerr 给出非物理参数。
analysis.reading_entry: Relativistic accretion-disc models
analysis.problem: 检验使用完全相对论吸积盘模型替代牛顿 diskbb 是否能显著改善 Cyg X-1 软态谱拟合，并评估由谱拟合得到的内盘半径、自旋和倾角。
analysis.method: 重新处理 2012 年 10 月 31 日的 Suzaku XIS 观测，在 1.2--10.0 keV 能段拟合谱；先建立包含 diskbb、powerlaw、reflionx 和 zxipcf 的基线模型，再分别用 kerrd、kerrbb、bhspec、slimdisk 和 superkerr 等模型替换 diskbb，同时保留吸收、风、康普顿化和反射处理。
assumptions: 软态下假设内盘半径等于最内稳定圆轨道半径（ISCO）。
采用光谱硬化因子 f=1.7 和边界条件因子 κ=0.412。
部分拟合中将质量、距离和倾角固定为参考测量值；kerrbb 中还假设内边界零力矩。
limits: 数据来自一次 Suzaku 观测，且分析能段为 1.2--10.0 keV，作者认为数据质量和有限能段导致模型参数张力。
部分模型的自旋、倾角、吸积率或硬化因子未约束、误差无法计算或达到参数边界。
